tier3_unseen_sentence.measures: unseen-sentence composition: at least one sentence never seen

gaps.note: a gap near zero means the tier names describe the same difficulty for this model; a large tier3 gap means the reported v57 perplexity was measuring recall of sentences rather than composition of them
